description: This file defines a React component named ViewCostDetailsModal, which renders a full-screen modal overlay displaying cost details, including a summary view and raw JSON data. It manages state for active tabs, user name fetching, and copy-to-clipboard functionality. The component also imports external utility functions, constants, and API calls, and it handles user interactions such as tab switching, copying JSON, and closing the modal.

methods.name: fallbackCopy
methods.description: Fallback method to copy text to clipboard using a temporary textarea element when navigator.clipboard is unavailable or fails.
